title: The Gramophone Pin Mystery
subtitle: A Curious Clue and a City Awakes
summary: When a cryptic newspaper advertisement piques Byomkesh Bakshi’s sharp curiosity, a seemingly ordinary morning transforms into the start of an unforgettable investigation. Against the vibrant backdrop of a bustling city, secrets begin to unspool from the simplest details. Can a bizarre clue hidden in plain sight lead to a mystery only Byomkesh can solve?
